book.title: Crit Hit & Run
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

chapters.title: Natural One to the Face
chapters.goal: Artie dies in a freak vending machine accident and wakes up in the 'Death-Trap Tutorial' of a broken LitRPG world.
chapters.stakes_shift: From mundane debt-ridden existence to immediate survival against level-scaled monstrosities.

bridge.from_prev: Artie's previous life as a failed actuary.
bridge.to_next: Artie escapes the tutorial with a broken 'Crit-and-Quit' passive but zero actual gear.

chapters.title: The Art of Not Being Hit
chapters.goal: Artie reaches the starter town and realizes his 'Luck' stat is so high it breaks the local economy and aggros the guards.
chapters.stakes_shift: From avoiding death to avoiding incarceration while trying to monetize his glitchy existence.

bridge.to_next: Artie is forced to take a high-risk contract to pay off his 'bounty' for existing.

chapters.title: Carry Me, Maybe?
chapters.goal: Artie joins a group of 'Heroic' paladins, pretending to be a legendary glass cannon while actually just exploiting line-of-sight bugs.
chapters.stakes_shift: From solo survival to managing a reputation he hasn't earned while investigating the party's true mission.

bridge.to_next: The party discovers a dungeon that shouldn't exist according to the world map.

chapters.title: The 0.01% Probability
chapters.goal: Artie must solo-clear the dungeon boss when his party is paralyzed, relying entirely on a chain of 1-in-a-million critical hits.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being a 'fake' hero to becoming a genuine, albeit terrified, powerhouse.

bridge.to_next: The boss drops an item that reveals the System is failing.

chapters.title: Divide by Zero
chapters.goal: Artie tracks down an 'Admin Ghost' to understand why his crits are breaking the reality-stability of the world.
chapters.stakes_shift: From personal progression to the potential collapse of the entire game world.

bridge.to_next: Artie realizes he needs to 'rob' the world's highest-level NPC to fix the leak.

chapters.title: The Grand Larceny of Reality
chapters.goal: Artie executes a high-speed heist on the Capital's vault to steal the 'Source Core' before the System deletes him as a bug.
chapters.stakes_shift: From being a fugitive to holding the keys to the world's source code.

bridge.from_prev: The plan to infiltrate the Capital.
bridge.to_next: The heist succeeds, but triggers a world-wide 'Emergency Maintenance' event.

chapters.title: Logging Off is for Losers
chapters.goal: Artie survives the initial maintenance purge and establishes a 'safe zone' for other 'glitched' players.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a lone exploiter to the reluctant leader of a digital rebellion.

bridge.to_next: Artie prepares for the inevitable 'Patch 2.0' that will try to erase him.

sections.title: The Ultimate Bad Beat
sections.intent: Establish Artie's mundane life and his absurdly unlucky death by vending machine.
sections.end_condition: Artie dies and the 'Death-Trap Tutorial' loading screen appears.

sections.title: Welcome to the Grinder
sections.intent: Artie navigates the initial tutorial traps and discovers his broken Luck stat.
sections.end_condition: Artie unlocks the 'Crit-and-Quit' passive skill.

sections.title: Bypassing the Gatekeeper
sections.intent: Artie uses his glitchy luck to skip the tutorial boss entirely.
sections.end_condition: Artie steps through the tutorial exit portal into the main world.

sections.title: The Oakhaven Arrival
sections.intent: Artie enters the starter town and realizes he has no gear but infinite potential for chaos.
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the town square and finds the local Potion Shop.

sections.title: The Potion Arbitrage
sections.intent: Artie exploits a shop-buyback bug caused by his Luck stat to generate infinite gold.
sections.end_condition: The local economy crashes and a bounty is placed on Artie's head.

sections.title: Cornered by the Law
sections.intent: Artie flees the town guards and is intercepted by a group of high-level Paladins.
sections.end_condition: Artie agrees to join the Paladins' quest to avoid immediate arrest.

sections.title: The Glass Cannon Audition
sections.intent: Artie bluffs his way into the party by pretending to be a high-level mage.
sections.end_condition: The party departs for the Forbidden Zone.

sections.title: Tactical Incompetence
sections.intent: Artie survives early skirmishes by exploiting line-of-sight bugs and friendly fire mechanics.
sections.end_condition: The party reaches the entrance of the glitched dungeon.

sections.title: Into the Deep End
sections.intent: The party enters the dungeon and discovers the environment is actively corrupting.
sections.end_condition: A massive trap isolates Artie from the rest of the party.

sections.title: Solo Queue Nightmares
sections.intent: Artie must navigate the inner sanctum alone while the Paladins are CC'd.
sections.end_condition: Artie enters the boss chamber of the Glitched Sentinel.

sections.title: The Chain of Luck
sections.intent: Artie engages the boss, relying on a continuous string of 0.01% critical hits to stay alive.
sections.end_condition: The Boss is defeated by a final, reality-warping critical strike.

sections.title: The Forbidden Loot
sections.intent: Artie loots the boss and discovers the Glitch-Shard, which talks back.
sections.end_condition: Artie reunites with his party, hiding the shard as they exit the dungeon.

sections.title: Signal in the Noise
sections.intent: Artie uses the Shard to track down the source of the world's instability.
sections.end_condition: Artie arrives at the 'Ghost Tavern' on the edge of the world map.

sections.title: The Admin's Lament
sections.intent: Artie meets the Admin Ghost and learns the System is scheduled for a full wipe.
sections.end_condition: The Admin Ghost reveals the location of the Source Core.

sections.title: The Bug Becomes a Feature
sections.intent: Artie decides to steal the Core to prevent the wipe, accepting his role as a 'Global Error'.
sections.end_condition: Artie begins the journey to the Capital's High Vault.

sections.title: Breaking the Capital
sections.intent: Artie infiltrates the most secure city in the game using 'unintended travel mechanics'.
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the doors of the Source Vault.

sections.title: The Grand Larceny
sections.intent: Artie bypasses the Vault's logic puzzles by literally breaking the physics engine.
sections.end_condition: Artie physically removes the Source Core from its pedestal.

sections.title: Emergency Maintenance
sections.intent: The System detects the theft and begins a world-wide shutdown sequence.
sections.end_condition: Artie escapes the Capital as the sky starts to pixelate and dissolve.

sections.title: The Deletion Wave
sections.intent: Artie fights off 'System Cleaners' while searching for a stable zone.
sections.end_condition: Artie finds a group of other glitched NPCs and players hiding in a void-pocket.

sections.title: Building the Firewall
sections.intent: Artie uses the Source Core to stabilize a permanent 'Safe Zone' for the glitched.
sections.end_condition: The Safe Zone is successfully shielded from the System's purge.

sections.title: Patch 2.0 Can Wait
sections.intent: Artie establishes himself as the leader of the digital resistance.
sections.end_condition: Artie sits on his new 'throne' and prepares for the first counter-attack against the System.
